# PUNDITS

> Pundit takes mapped onto Kalshi markets. Hypothetical $100 at the freeze. Not affiliated with Kalshi or the pundits.

PUNDITS is a public ledger of first-person sports picks. Each card is a Kalshi YES/NO contract. Faces are named pundits on that side. Pick stories are generated from mapped hard rows; they are not freehand essays.

## Site
- https://pundits.pro/
- https://pundits.pro/ncaaf/
- https://pundits.pro/nfl/
- https://pundits.pro/book/
- https://pundits.pro/stories/
- https://pundits.pro/leaderboard/
- https://pundits.pro/sitemap.xml

## How to read it
- `/stories` is the index of pick stories.
- `/picks/{event}-{season}` is the market page (game or future). `season` is the year the regular season starts (`clemson-at-lsu-2026`, `rams-sb-2026`), even when the game or Super Bowl is in January/February 2027. The page labels that span `2026–27`.
- `/picks/{event}-{season}/{pundit}` is the pick story: who picked whom, underdog, quote, freeze.
- `/pundits/{id}` is that voice's book.
- Quotes are verified first-person. Soft takes stay in The Book until they map.
